name: The Object
description: A large invisible celestial mass above the Drownyard that the journal says is pulling the tides and moon, appearing to Jace as a blind spot.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 735 traces the stones and tidal distortion to a large reef off the Nephalian coast.
timeline.quote: a large reef off the coast of Nephalia

timeline.summary: A blind spot at the dome's center swells into a huge Object, and illusory duplicates of Jace appear around him.
timeline.quote: The blind spot in his vision had swelled to become an Object far larger than Jace himself

timeline.summary: The dome shatters, revealing a latticed wall of eyes; Jace awakens on the path while the fisherwoman flees.
timeline.quote: His eyes snapped open to find his hands clapped over his head, his body curled up on the ground.

timeline.summary: The journal proposes that an eldritch moon of great mass is nearing Innistrad.
timeline.quote: an eldritch moon of sufficient size as to provide a gravitational pull

timeline.summary: Jace is zapped by a stone again and perceives the Object hovering above the circle, the nexus of Innistrad's redirected leylines.
timeline.quote: A blind spot, the Object, loomed in his vision, hovering just above the circle of stones in the distance.

timeline.summary: The Object disappears from above the ring.

pages_say.description: A large invisible celestial mass above the Drownyard that the journal says is pulling the tides and moon, appearing to Jace as a blind spot.
